scientific_limitations: The distributional formulas assume exactly three alternatives, independent uniform strict rankings and singleton approval of each voter's first choice.
The sharp rational prefactor is proved along voter counts divisible by six; the logarithmic rate holds for every voter count.
This does not characterize the disapproval Smith set composition, manipulation, or nonuniform preference cultures.
Independent review has not been performed and indexed searches cannot exclude all equivalent unpublished work.
title: Rare-event law for approval-weighted veto consent with three alternatives
